description: The NITROX II CN2130 is one member of the Cavium Networks award winning NITROX, NITROX Lite, and NITROX II line of security processors. Based on a common hardware processor core, the NITROX families deliver 50Mbs to 10Gbps of encryption bandwidth with 1K to 40K RSA/DH operations per second. NITROX processors and acceleration boards are being used by server-motherboard vendors and OEMs in a wide range of networking equipment to accelerate security protocols and algorithms.
